description: Post a short "Connected to <hub>." message, in the hub's language, in one of a chat app bridge's allowed chats (POST /v1/bridges/{id}/test). Everyone in that chat sees it. chatId must be in the bridge's allowed list (422 bridge_chat_not_allowed otherwise). Only chat apps with the test_message helper have one (Telegram and Discord; 409 bridge_helper_unavailable otherwise: mention the bot in the chat instead). A few test messages an hour per bridge; past that, 429 says how long to wait. Needs a paid plan. Requires the hubs:write scope, and the hub's owner or a workspace manager.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

bridgeId.description: Bridge UUID: the id from thalovant_list_bridges.

chatId.description: An id from the bridge's allowed list.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

name: thalovant_send_bridge_test_message
title: Send Bridge Test Message
